guard: Explicit full resolution survives native account updates and restart without weakening default or input discipline
why: The changed public renderer feeds real private native servers. Actual signed claim updates, holder eviction, new connects and process restart distinguish disk resolution from the unchanged memory control. No CLI/service policy or hosted agent acceptance is claimed.

mutations.name: inherited memory kind hides unknown own field
mutations.expectRed: unknown null and expanded memory options refuse instead of falling back
mutations.cell: unknown null and expanded memory options refuse instead of falling back

mutations.name: full selection emits memory
mutations.find: return `resolver: { type: full, dir: ${JSON.stringify(resolver.directory)}, allow_delete: false, interval: "${resolver.intervalMs}ms", limit: ${resolver.limit} }\n`;
mutations.expectRed: full restart keeps the original preload and observed key policy
mutations.cell: full restart keeps the original preload and observed key policy

mutations.name: full resolution permits deletion
mutations.expectRed: full renderer emits native capacity interval and no-delete settings
mutations.cell: full renderer emits native capacity interval and no-delete settings

mutations.name: relative resolver directory is admitted

mutations.cell: relative empty and control-character directories refuse

mutations.name: zero capacity is admitted

mutations.cell: zero and fractional native capacity refuse
